cohort: 60 pregnant women with a history of preeclampsia, fetal growth restriction, placental abruption, or stillbirth (>20 weeks)
finding: Prophylactic LMWH administration before 15 weeks of gestation was associated with improved perinatal outcomes, including reduced nursery/NICU admissions and increased gestational age and birth weight at delivery.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was not significantly different between the LMWH and control groups.
